content: Nuuni haasaya gitabay hessa. Saluwan Ubbaafe Bolla Xoossaa araatape ushacha baggan uttida haysa mela kahine halaqay nuus de7ees.
I asan gidonashin, Godan eqida tuma dunkaaniyan xoossa keethan oothees.
Kahine halaqa ubbay imonne yarsho yarshanaw shuumetees. Hessa gisho, ha kahiney yarshanaw issibay daanaw koshshees.
Higgey kiiteysada yarshiya kahineti de7iya gisho, Kiristoosi sa7an de7iyaba gidiyako I kahine gidenna.
Enti kahinetethan oothiya dunkaaney salon de7eysas leemisonne kuya. Musey dunkaaniya essiya wode Xoossay iyako, “Taani nena zumaa bolla bessida leemisuwa kaallada ootha” yaagis.
Shin Yesuusi giddo gididi sigethiya caaqoy, koyro caaquwape aadheysada I ekida oosoy entaysafe aadhees. Hessi eqiday aadhiya caaqo qaalana.
Koyro caaquwan bali baynaba gidiyako nam7antho caaqo koshshenna.
Shin Goday enta boridi, haysada yaagis:

content.text: He caaqoy ta enta aawata Gibxe biittafe kushiya oykada,
goocha kessida wode entara caaqida caaquwa mela gidenna.
taani enta yegga aggas yaagees Goday.
ta caaqana caaqoy haysa yaagees Goday.
Taani ta higgiya enta guuggiyan wothana;
Entafe oonika ba shooruwa woyko ba ishaa,

content: Xoossay ha caaquwa “Oorathi” gidi xeegishe koyroysa gal7isis. Hiza, gal7aynne ceegay dhayiya wodey gakis.
